user.title: Configure Bosch BTH-RM / BTH-RA and AHC
user.description: Controlled BETA. Select ONE AHC schedule. Radiator climate and operating-mode select lists must be in exactly the same order; each pair must belong to the same HA device. Output starts OFF; experimental guarded auto-resume can be explicitly opted into later. The AHC automation is optional during initial setup; select it later with Configure after the virtual climate exists.

init.title: Assign AHC and configure auto-resume
init.description: Experimental: auto-enable after restart only with fresh AHC, MQTT and radiator state reports and 90 seconds stable readiness. OFF by default. State reports are not Zigbee ACKs; unattended operation remains unverified.

data.auto_resume: Experimental guarded auto-resume after restart (OFF by default)
